prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agency—“best” depends on your specific needs (services, budget, audience, regulatory constraints, outcome metrics). I can help you find the best fit. A quick way to proceed is:

1) Quick questions so I can narrow recommendations
- What part of healthcare are you in? (hospital system, clinic, urgent care, medical device, biotech, pharma, payer, behavioral health, senior care, etc.)
- What services do you need? (brand/creative, digital advertising, content/SEO, PR, patient acquisition, B2B sales enablement, product launch, regulatory messaging, analytics)
- Is HIPAA/FDA/regulatory experience required?
- Geographic target (St. Louis metro only, regional, national)?
- Rough budget or monthly retainer range?
- Timeline or upcoming launch/initiative?

2) How I can help next
- If you give the answers above I’ll compile a tailored shortlist of St. Louis agencies experienced in healthcare (with strengths, typical client types, example case study metrics when available).
- Or I can give a general shortlist of notable local agencies that often work with health clients (if you want that immediately I can research and list 5–8).

3) How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Direct healthcare experience (and specific experience in your sub-sector)
- Documented outcomes: case studies with KPIs (lead cost, conversion, patient volume, revenue impact)
- Regulatory/compliance competence (HIPAA, FDA, PHI handling policies)
- Integrated capabilities (strategy, creative, digital, analytics) or clear partnerships for gaps
- Measurement & reporting (dashboards, attribution models)
- Client references and retention rate

4) Suggested interview / RFP questions to ask an agency
- Tell me about 2 similar healthcare clients and the outcomes you delivered (specific KPIs).
- How do you handle PHI in marketing programs? What security controls and BAAs do you use?
- Who will be the day-to-day team, and what are their healthcare backgrounds?
- How do you measure ROI and attribute outcomes to your work?
- What’s your approach to patient acquisition vs. brand awareness for healthcare?
- Can you show creative and landing pages you built for healthcare clients (and conversion data)?
- What are typical fees and contract terms? How do you handle scope changes?
- How do you coordinate with internal clinical/legal/compliance teams?
- How quickly can you start and what onboarding process do you follow?

If you’d like, tell me the answers to the 6 quick questions above and I’ll return a tailored shortlist of top St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies and recommended next steps. Which option do you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
